title: Cofactor Genomics’ Immunotherapy Predictive Diagnostic, OncoPrism, Completes Validation and Moves Into Clinical Use in Head and Neck Cancer Patients
summary: Twenty-five institutions collaborate with Cofactor to validate OncoPrism for use in head and neck cancer patients.
